items.text: On two medical and oncology wards over six months from February 2027, can a serious illness conversation template with prompts and a skills session be delivered, can note quality be rated reliably, and can bereaved families be reached well enough to justify a stepped-wedge trial across six wards?
items.population: Patients meeting prognostic triggers on two wards, their clinicians and bereaved families
items.intervention: Template with prompts, 60-minute skills session and monthly feedback
items.comparator: 2025 baseline documentation on the same wards
items.outcome: Delivery, rater agreement, extraction time, family response, and preliminary change in documentation and quality
items.setting: Two wards of a teaching hospital

finer: Feasible within the grant and analyst hours; interesting to the research office; novel in measuring quality alongside documentation; ethical with a waiver for chart review and consent for family contact; relevant because it decides whether a trial is worth running.
summary: One feasibility question with progression criteria.
